logp.method_description: The ruthenium compounds (Ru-1 to Ru-4) were prepared at 25 μg/mL in n-octanol. An aliquot of each solution was combined with an equal volume of water and vigorously agitated for 6 h. After the mixture was allowed to equilibrate overnight, the distinctive UV absorption of each complex was measured. Variations in absorbance between the organic and aqueous layers were subsequently evaluated.
